content:
Travis Kelce says he’s glad social media users are having a “good old time” turning a viral moment between him and his wife, Taylor Swift, into a myriad of relatable internet memes.

The viral moment happened on Sep. 20, when Swift was caught on camera showing off her wedding ring after Kelce, star tight end for the Kansas City Chiefs, scored his first touchdown of the NFL season in a game against the Indianapolis Colts.

Swift appeared to say, “That’s my husband!” from her suite at Arrowhead Stadium as he ran the ball into the end zone, as seen in clips on social media. The Chiefs ultimately won 33-30.

Kelce had a sweet reaction to the moment that’s been making the rounds on social media during Wednesday’s episode of the “New Heights” podcast alongside his older brother, Jason Kelce.

“Just doing my deed as a husband,” Travis Kelce gushed after his brother mentioned that the internet has been “running wild” with Swift’s reaction.

“Listen man, proud wife, baby. Gotta make my girl proud,” he added.

The brother duo also read aloud some of the memes during the episode.

“My wife when I figure out which alarm was tripping due to low battery and swipe it out,” one meme read alongside the image of Swift during the celebratory moment at the game.

“These are awesome,” Jason Kelce responded.

Swift and Travis Kelce tied the knot at their star-studded wedding ceremony in Madison Square Garden on July 3.
